title: Interfacial chemistry governs SERS detectability of trimethoprim and ketoprofen: adsorption geometry and chloride-mediated activation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,40883-40896
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07249B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Dao Thi Nguyet Nga, Ha Anh Nguyen, Mai Quan Doan, Anh-Tuan Le
Electrochemically grown AgNP SERS sensors deliver nanomolar detection of TMP and chloride-activated KTP, demonstrating adsorption-driven enhancement and robust results in real samples for environmental monitoring and pharma quality control.
